div.div: 6 تفاطموا Their lambs, or kids, (بَهْمُهُمْ, [in the CK, erroneously, بُهْمُهُمْ,]) kept to their mothers after the weaning, or ablactation; (K, TA;) therefore this [person] gave, or delivered, his lambs, or kids, to this; and this [person], his lambs, or kids, to this. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
